Are you passionate about project management and delivering innovative solutions that align with business goals? Do you excel at leading cross-functional teams to successfully implement complex projects? If so, you might be the new Solutions Project Manager at Hempel.

**About The Job

**We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Solutions Project Manager to oversee the planning, development, and delivery of solutions that support business objectives and customer needs. This role requires a combination of project management expertise and strategic thinking to drive successful implementation across multiple stakeholders and teams.

You’ll collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication and alignment on project goals. Your ability to manage risks, track performance, and drive continuous improvement will be key to delivering high-quality solutions.

**What You Can Look Forward To In This Role

**Reporting to Director for Marine Solution Management, you will play a critical role in delivering impactful solutions and optimizing project execution. Your expertise in project management will ensure successful planning and delivery of initiatives that enhance business performance.

**You Will Make An Impact By

**

• Developing and managing detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets for solution delivery.

• Coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables.

• Collaborating with internal stakeholders to define solution requirements and oversee implementation.

• Acting as the primary point of contact for external customers and partners during the project lifecycle.

• Overseeing the testing, deployment, and integration of solutions into existing systems.

• Ensuring quality assurance processes are followed throughout the project.

• Tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure project success and solution effectiveness.

• Identifying areas for improvement in solution delivery processes and implementing best practices.

**To Thrive In This Role, You

**

• Have a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Information Technology, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.

• Have 5+ years of experience in project management, solution management, or a related role.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify risks and implement mitigation strategies.

• Have proven ability to engage, influence, and manage expectations of diverse stakeholders, including technical teams, customers, and senior management.

• Have excellent communication skills, tailoring messaging to various stakeholders.

• Demonstrate the ability to plan, execute, monitor, and close projects effectively.

• Are adaptable, innovative, and customer-focused in your approach.

**Key Stakeholders

**

• Customers

• Sales Team

• R&D

• Business Development

• Solutions Management

• Product Management

• Services

• Commercial Excellence

• Marine Performance Advisory

**Global career possibilities

**At Hempel, we offer a variety of global career possibilities and many cross-functional and cross-cultural working relationships. We strive to create the right conditions for personal and professional development.

Join a global company where employees are truly passionate about delivering the best in everything they do. With business in mind and people at heart, we always work together to influence our road ahead. We want you to be part of our growth journey and of a great global family.

**Sounds like a match?

__We’re on a mission to double our impact. To succeed, we need bright minds and team players. Which is why, from day one, your input, ideas and initiative are not only welcomed, but expected. In return, you will enjoy great opportunities for development in a growing global company – and be part of the solution by contributing to our global impact.

_At Hempel, we are committed to everyone feeling safe, valued and treated equally, in an environment where each employee can bring their authentic selves to work. We believe that inclusion is key to innovation and by bringing together the most diverse perspectives and talents, we can achieve great things, together.

Join us and help shape PtX (Power-to-X) and BtX (Bio-to-X) projects on a global scale, working with an experienced team on the solutions of the future.

At Blue Power Partners, we are a global consultancy and project development company dedicated to delivering renewable energy solutions that support sustainable change. Our core expertise is conceptual design and economic modeling of entire complexes, including wind and solar farms, power sourcing, and downstream PtX and BtX facilities.

We work closely with our clients, who include one of the world’s largest fund managers in greenfield renewable energy.

**About the job

**We are looking for an experienced Senior Process Engineer to contribute to the development of PtX and BtX facilities worldwide. You will join a team of skilled specialists in a role with a wide variety of tasks. The key deliverables are due diligence, feasibility analysis, and initial conceptual design.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading process development, including feasibility studies and pre-FEED, and sharing your process expertise as a technical advisor

• Working with our modeling team on techno-economic optimization by providing technical and economic input

• Taking part in technical classification meetings, exhibit reviews, and negotiations

• Supporting proposals, tender processes, safety assessments, and plant commissioning

• Helping develop in-house tools, such as techno-economic calculation models, to support concept design and benchmarking of PtX and BtX projects

• Coordinating across project disciplines and stakeholders

• Managing third-party verification

• Contributing to knowledge sharing and smooth project delivery

You will work from our office in Copenhagen (Tromsøgade 2, Nordhavn) or Aalborg HQ (John F. Kennedys Plads 43). Because we work globally, the role sometimes calls for flexibility, and we offer the same in return.

**About you

**You are curious and enjoy learning. You like working in a structured, thoughtful way, and you thrive in an international, multicultural environment where adaptability and teamwork matter.

We are looking for someone who brings:

• An MSc in chemical engineering or another relevant engineering field

• Around 10 years of experience with chemical processes

• Strong process experience, including PFDs, process modeling tools (e.g., Aspen HYSYS, DWSIM), equipment design, P&IDs, and process safety

• A solid understanding of thermodynamics, reaction engineering, fluid flow, heat transfer, and mass transfer

• Hands-on experience with one or more PtX or BtX production processes, such as electrolysis, steam methane reforming (SMR), Haber-Bosch, methanol synthesis, methanation, synthesis of higher hydrocarbons (SAF), refinery processes, biomass processing, carbon capture, or CO2 sequestration

• Good collaboration and organizational skills

• Fluent written and spoken English

**Contact

**For more information about the position, please contact Anne Krog Jensen, Head of PtX & Molecules, at akj@bluepp.dk.

To apply, upload your resume through our recruitment system via the “Apply” link. We don’t accept applications by email.

**Why join Blue Power Partners?

**At Blue Power Partners, we value belonging, purpose, and diverse perspectives, and we believe they contribute to our innovation and long-term success. Our organization is built on trust, entrepreneurship, and balance. You will join a focused team working on specialized technical projects, where you can grow your expertise in PtX and BtX. Joining BPP means becoming part of a consultancy that is contributing to the energy transition, with strong technical roots and an international scope.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Quality Engineer (m/f/d) within our global Quality Center of Expertise (COE) in Danfoss Sensing Solutions (SEN) you will contribute to shaping quality excellence in a rapidly growing business.

You will serve as a versatile contributor across customer, supplier, project and quality management areas. You will work closely with the local Quality teams in China, Europe and Mexico as well as with our Customer Quality Managers and report to the global head of SEN Quality COE.

At Danfoss, we believe quality is a key enabler of innovation and customer success. In this role, you'll help strengthen our global quality culture while supporting the growth of our Sensing Solutions business.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Identify improvement opportunities through KPI monitoring, data analytics (incl. AI), process reviews, and internal/external benchmarking; foster sharing with other sites.

• Lead or support internal Quality Initiatives and continuous improvement projects.

• Participate in Supplier selection, monitoring, auditing and continuous development activities.

• Govern and maintain the global SEN Quality & EHS Management System incl. managing external 3rd Party Audits on ISO 9001 and IATF 16949.

• Act as subject matter expert for systems & tools such as Q.wiki, APIS, SAP, One CRM, Power BI, PLM and provide guidance and coaching to employees.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience will also be considered.

• Advanced knowledge of quality management principles and quality core tools such as APQP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, Control Plans and problem-solving methodologies.

• Self-driven, flexible, structured and persistent work style with the ability to manage multiple tasks in parallel.

• Strong ability to communicate factually and appropriately with all internal and external stakeholders, mainly in English.

• Skills such as risk and change management, coaching, team facilitation, also in difficult situations.

• Strong digital mindset with an affinity for data analytics, AI-enabled quality processes, and enterprise systems.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

**Shaping Our Ai Capabilities

**Are you motivated by building the platform that powers a company's AI ambitions, alongside a team of highly skilled and similarly motivated engineers? Then you may just be the perfect fit for our Cloud Platform team in STARK Group IT.

We are at the early stages of establishing an AI Center of Excellence in partnership with the CTO Office, and our Platform team is building the infrastructure capabilities needed to support it, from hosting AI agents to enabling on-prem AI workloads. This is an opportunity to help shape those capabilities as they evolve.

**The mission, should you choose to accept it

**As our new Senior Platform Engineer, you will join our existing cloud team, taking responsibility for applying modern cloud disciplines and technologies to design and implement the Cloud Platform used by more than 17 development teams and powering solutions for our 20,000 global employees. Increasingly, that also means helping shape how AI is used across the company - working hand in hand with the CTO's office as they build out the AI Center of Excellence, contributing to what "good" looks like for agentic usage, cost and credit management, agent scaling, and building the platform capabilities that make it all work in practice.

This isn't just an infrastructure role. You'll help define guidance and best practices alongside the CoE, as well as build the platform underneath it - a rare chance to shape both the standards and the systems from the ground up. You'll become part of a highly performant, international team that gives you plenty of freedom in how you work, along with responsibility to make your own impact.

Your work with us will primarily, but not exclusively, revolve around the following areas:

• Expand our Azure Cloud capabilities, leaning on IaC as your main tool and following the principles of the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.

• Build and operate the infrastructure for agentic AI workloads, including agent hosting, orchestration, and the platform capabilities needed to run them reliably at scale.

• Build toward a truly hybrid AI setup, pairing cloud-native AI capabilities with on-prem infrastructure so workloads can run wherever makes the most sense.

• Contribute to the guidance and standards coming out of the AI CoE, helping define what "good" looks like for agentic usage, credit and cost management, and agent scaling across the company.

• Strengthen and tune our Kubernetes workloads, making sure they run with the performance, resilience, and efficiency our business depends on.

• Drive a Platform Engineering approach to our cloud and AI infrastructure and tooling, working closely with Software Engineering teams and the AI CoE to build cohesive, developer-friendly experiences.

• Deliver on a modern, secure, and scalable cloud architecture, which you will help shape - one that's increasingly built with AI workloads in mind.

To succeed in this role, we are not just looking for someone who checks boxes - we're looking for someone honest, vocal, and unafraid to challenge the status quo when you see ways we can improve.

**Who are we looking for?

**So, if you enjoy spotting the glitches in the Matrix before anyone else does, or you’ve ever whispered "it's always DNS" to yourself (even when the culprit turned out to be a misbehaving agent), we consider that a positive sign.

Those qualities tend to go hand in hand with what we're looking for: someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, isn't afraid to challenge established ways of working, and combines technical depth with a pragmatic mindset, helping us build and evolve the platform capabilities that support both today's cloud services and tomorrow's AI ambitions.

The skills that will help you thrive include:

• A solid grasp of the Azure Cloud ecosystem, understanding both its opportunities and its boundaries.

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code, ideally with Bicep, and the ability to bring structure, clarity, and repeatability to how we build cloud resources.

• Comfort with scripting, whether your tool of choice is Python, Bash, or PowerShell, to automate tasks and streamline operational workflows.

• Experience with Kubernetes fundamentals, including deployments, services, and scaling.

• Curiosity about or exposure to AI infrastructure concepts - things like model hosting, agent orchestration frameworks, or GPU-backed workloads - even if you're not an AI expert yet.

• General familiarity with CI/CD and networking, giving you a well-rounded foundation for how we do cloud engineering.

**Welcome to Group IT

**When joining Group IT, you will be joining a digital transformation journey as we replace our legacy systems and transition towards a modular and flexible integrated setup. Group IT, a dynamic and rapidly evolving part of STARK Group, is responsible for delivering groupwide business-critical IT solutions. We strive to modernize and reimagine the IT landscape to ensure both scalability and composability to meet existing and future business needs, and we would like your help to rethink the way things are done in our industry to offer our customers a superior experience.

**Want to know more and apply?

**We will be happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your options in STARK Group. You are welcome to contact Magnus Bech Larsen, magnus.larsen@stark.dk for any specific questions regarding the role.

Director, Lab Consulting

About the role

NNIT is looking for a Director to lead our Lab Consulting team within the Digital Manufacturing division.

This is a senior leadership role for an experienced consulting leader with strong knowledge of life sciences, laboratory processes, lab digitalization and manufacturing IT. You will lead a team of consultants across Europe and take responsibility for developing our Lab Consulting business, strengthening delivery quality and building trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders.

You will work closely with the Digital Manufacturing leadership team and Advisory team to shape our services, support strategic customer engagements and contribute to continued growth in a highly regulated industry.

Your responsibilities:

Leadership and people development

• Lead, develop and grow the Lab Consulting team across Europe

• Set direction for the team and ensure alignment with business priorities and customer needs

• Build the right capabilities to support consulting delivery within life sciences and regulated manufacturing

• Coach and mentor consultants in consulting excellence, customer engagement and NNIT ways of working

• Manage performance, development plans and succession planning for team members

• Identify capability gaps and support relevant training, coaching and mentoring

• Drive engagement, collaboration and knowledge sharing across locations

• Support effective workforce planning in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders

Lab consulting and delivery quality

• Support complex customer engagements from early dialogue through delivery

• Strengthen governance, reporting and delivery follow up across the team

• Resolve escalations and support constructive collaboration with customers and internal teams

• Ensure delivery activities are properly reflected in relevant NNIT systems and processes

• Promote consistency, quality and continuous improvement across customer assignments

Customer engagement and business development

• Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders in life sciences and pharma

• Lead and participate in strategic customer engagements during sales and delivery

• Translate customer challenges, market needs and industry trends into relevant consulting services

• Support proposals, customer presentations and request for proposal processes

• Contribute to the development of new services, delivery models and quality improvements

• Work closely with Digital Manufacturing leadership and Advisory teams on strategic priorities

• Represent NNIT as a senior leader in customer meetings, industry discussions and strategic dialogues

Business performance

• Contribute to planning, forecasting and operational follow up for the Lab Consulting area

• Support financial transparency and informed decision making

• Contribute to strong business performance and sustainable growth

• Support prioritization of opportunities, resources and customer commitments

• Provide clear communication and relevant input to leadership on performance, risks and opportunities

Your qualifications:

Essential requirements

• A bachelor level qualification in a relevant engineering, technical, scientific or business discipline

• Proven leadership experience, including people management, coaching and development

• Strong experience within life sciences, pharma or regulated manufacturing environments

• Experience with laboratory processes, lab digitalization or manufacturing IT in life sciences

• Proven experience with consulting delivery, stakeholder management and customer engagement

• Strong business understanding and the ability to translate customer and market needs into consulting services

• Excellent communication skills with both senior customer stakeholders and internal leadership teams

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to lead across countries, cultures and functions

Preferred qualifications

• A master level qualification in a relevant engineering, technical, scientific or business discipline

• Background in financial management, forecasting and operational follow up

• Familiarity with budget ownership and P&L responsibility

• Proven ability to support business development, proposals and request for proposal processes

• Leadership of distributed teams across Europe

• Involvement in developing consulting offerings or service portfolios within life sciences

What NNIT offers you:

• A senior leadership role in the Digital Manufacturing division with significant responsibility and influence

• The opportunity to shape and grow the Lab Consulting business in a life sciences focused organization

• A company with more than 25 years of experience as a trusted partner to some of the world’s largest life sciences companies

• Strong opportunities for professional and leadership development

• A competitive compensation and benefits package

Apply now to make your mark.

About NNIT

NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

Develop advanced power electronics for high-performance laser systems

Do you want to work hands-on with power electronics in a highly specialized R&D environment, developing solutions used in advanced laser and photonics technologies?

Hamamatsu Photonics A/S is expanding its R&D organization and is looking for a Senior Power Electronics Engineer to strengthen its electronics capabilities.

About the Company

Hamamatsu Photonics is a global leader in photonics, laser and fibre technologies, employing more than 5,800 people worldwide.

Following the acquisition of NKT Photonics in 2024, the former NKT Photonics organisation now operates as the Lasers & Fibers Business Unit within the Hamamatsu Photonics Group, supporting applications within Quantum Technologies, Life Sciences, Semiconductors, Aerospace & Defence and Advanced Industrial Technologies.

Responsibilities

As Senior Power Electronics Engineer, you will take ownership of electronics development across the full product lifecycle—from early concept and design to validation, production, and optimization.

You will work in a multidisciplinary R&D environment, contributing to both detailed design and system-level solutions. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role with high ownership.

The role is based in Birkerød, Denmark and reports to the Team Lead Electronics.

Key responsibilities:

• Design and develop power electronics for laser systems across the full product lifecycle

• Own technical work packages and ensure delivery within scope, timeline, and quality targets

• Develop system-level electronics architectures and design concepts

• Collaborate closely with experts in optics, mechanics, and system design

• Create reference designs to support scalability and standardization

• Support manufacturing, custom solutions, and product improvements

• Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and certification requirements

What you will be doing (in practice)

• Working on low-volume, high-margin, high-complexity systems

• Translating unclear or evolving customer requirements into robust technical solutions

• Contributing to both detailed circuit design and overall system performance

• Taking ownership of solutions from idea → design → validation → production

Profile

You are a strong power electronics specialist with experience developing complex systems and a structured, solution-oriented mindset.

Experience

• Senior-level experience in power electronics development (100W–10kW range)

• Strong track record in PCB design and product development

• Experience working across the full product lifecycle

• Comfortable working in complex and evolving R&D environments

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders

Technical expertise

You have strong experience in several of the following:

Power electronics design

• DC/DC converter design and verification (kW range)

• Analog circuit design (control loops, amplifiers, inrush circuits)

Hardware & components

• Magnetic component design (inductors, transformers, chokes)

• PCB design and productization

Simulation & analysis

• Circuit simulation (e.g. LTspice, Pspice)

• Worst-case analysis, component stress, MTBF, DFMEA

General

• Strong understanding of switch-mode power electronics technologies

• Experience working with external partners or suppliers

Benefits

Hamamatsu Photonics offers a highly innovative and collaborative working environment where you can influence both technology and product development while being part of a globally recognized photonics organization.

You can expect:

• Market-competitive salary, including relocation support on a case-by-case basis

• 12% employer-paid pension scheme

• Annual bonus

• A highly dynamic and growing business environment with strong long-term potential

• High degree of autonomy and technical ownership

• Exposure to senior leadership and international projects

• A multicultural, knowledge-driven environment with highly skilled colleagues

• Strong opportunities for professional growth and career development as the organization continues to scale

About Portchain

Portchain exists to make maritime shipping more predictable, efficient, and green. We help shipping companies and terminals coordinate around shared, trustworthy information to reduce delays, fuel consumption, and emissions.

Our products support some of the world’s largest shipping companies, with more than 200 terminals connected through the Portchain Network.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep backend experience in Node.js and TypeScript.

You’ll build services, APIs, and integrations that power carrier and terminal workflows, berth planning, and new products. Working closely with Product, you’ll turn customer problems into simple, scalable solutions and own your work from design through production.

Our stack includes Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud, with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and Datadog.

How we work

Product teams of four or more engineers, each supported by a dedicated Product Manager, but with overlap between teams when needed.

We care about craftsmanship: understandable code, trustworthy high quality data, thoughtful user experiences, and systems that remain reliable and maintainable. We balance that care with pragmatic decisions and still deploy 10+ per day.

Curiosity matters here. We ask questions, explore customer problems, challenge assumptions, and learn from each other and from mistakes without blame.

How we use AI

AI is a core part of our engineering workflow. We use it for exploration, implementation, review, and technical sparring, and share useful practices with the team. We move faster than any of our customers, but not at the expense of quality or engineering understanding of behavior.

The final judgment remains with the engineer. We expect you to understand, review, validate, and be able to defend the code and decisions you ship, while protecting customer and company data.

What we’re looking for

• Substantial experience building and operating production backend systems with Node.js and TypeScript, including asynchronous execution, error handling, and diagnosing production issues.

• Strong relational database skills: schema design, SQL, transactions, and query performance. We use PostgreSQL.

• Experience designing robust APIs and integrating systems with different data formats and reliability characteristics.

• Experience deploying and operating software on GCP, AWS, Azure, or a similar cloud platform. We use GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL etc.)

• Sound architectural judgment, pride in your craft, and the ability to turn loosely defined problems into pragmatic solutions.

• Curiosity about unfamiliar domains and technologies, clear communication, and a collaborative approach to end-to-end ownership.

Useful extras include

GCP/Cloud Run, Terraform, CI/CD and observability, complex data ingestion, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 experience, and breadth across languages or technical side projects.

What we offer

• Meaningful work with global economic and environmental impact.

• Influence over products, architecture, and ways of working.

• Experienced, curious, and supportive colleagues.

• Competitive compensation and pension.

• Flexible working hours in our Copenhagen office.

• Subsidized lunch, snacks, and drinks.

• A dedicated development budget and support for continued learning.

If the role sounds exciting and you believe you can contribute, we would like to hear from you.

• Creating an interaction platform that enables Customer Service teams to engage with customers efficiently when support is needed, supported by a knowledge base that enhances the overall customer experience.

• Control Tower:

• Developing our internal platform for managing customer bookings, providing Customer Service with a more seamless and standardised way of handling bookings and tracking units across the DFDS network.

As an intern, you will work across all three pillars, supporting and driving the planning, coordination, and delivery of transformation initiatives. You will gain exposure to business and technology stakeholders and help ensure that projects move forward efficiently while creating value for our Customer Service organisation and customers.

**Examples Of Responsibilities

**

• Lead and assist on projects in various areas along the customer journey to help drive digitisation and standardisation across the DFDS Ferry domain (e.g. standardising customer service and sales processes)

• Drive or assist with project planning, coordination, and follow-up on key initiatives depending on size of project

• Prepare presentations for key stakeholders at all levels of the organisation including the executive suite

• Manage stakeholders e.g. local DFDS offices, and help roll out digitalisation and standardisation initiatives by interacting with particularly local customer service teams

• Conduct end-to-end process explorations and ad-hoc analyses, incl. building business cases

• Helping track project progress, dependencies, risks, and actions across initiatives

• Support with implementations e.g. testing, plan change management activities and ensure solutions are properly adopted

You will gain hands-on experience with large-scale business transformation, digital product development, process improvement, and change management in an international organisation.

You will play an important supporting role in our Customer Service transformation by helping teams stay aligned, ensuring key activities are coordinated effectively, and contributing to the successful adoption of new digital solutions and ways of working across the organisation.

**About You

**Are you eager to deepen your knowledge in the field of digital freight, and do you have a strong work ethic and passion for learning? Then this internship is for you!

**Additionally, We Are Looking For You Who Have

**

• A positive and curious mindset, also in dynamic periods

• A desire to make an impact, share your ideas and learn from others

• You keep things on track and get the details right

• Good collaboration skills, excited to contribute to an international organisation with colleagues from diverse backgrounds

**Furthermore, You Are

**

• Studying BSc International Shipping & Trade at Copenhagen Business School, ready to intern from September 2027

• A natural problem solver, when working individually and in a team

• Detail-oriented, ensuring accuracy in your work

• Proactive in identifying and understanding data sources and solutions to data collection

• Confident using Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel and PowerPoint. Power BI or similar tools is a plus

• Curious about AI and eager to use it to solve real business problems

We believe the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. And we cannot wait for you to join.

**Working at DFDS

**We promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. Our newly built headquarters in Copenhagen is a unique, modern workplace. Here, we enjoy our own game room, fitness & massage, cantina and café, and a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

You’ll get the opportunity to join our student community, where you can participate in social and professional activities, connecting with fellow students from various departments across the organisation.

We plan to welcome three interns from BSc International Shipping & Trade in 2027, one in Global Customer Service, one in Direct Procurement and one in Procurement Technology, Sustainability & Operations. This gives you a chance to join a cohort where you can share experiences, exchange ideas, and grow together.

**Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.

**If you think your personality, skills and desire match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply as soon as possible, as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

For questions about the recruitment, contact metboes@dfds.com.

We look forward to hearing from you.

**Your impact begins here

**As Advanced data analyst in CMC Pilots, you will turn manufacturing and supply chain data into faster, better-informed decisions. You will scope, build and maintain the analytics that help colleagues get the most out of our production facilities and execute their processes better. As production demands rise to deliver Novo’s clinical pipeline, your work helps CMC Pilots act with clarity and pace, to ensure Novo have the API and Drug Product to deliver our clinical trials on time.

**What You’ll Bring

**You will bring a background in manufacturing, chemistry, business analytics, data science or a related field, and the confidence to take an idea from definition to a working tool that people use.

• A Master’s degree. The field is flexible, for example engineering, business, IT, logistics or similar.

• At least 2 years of relevant experience from manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, production or a similar operational environment.

• Experience scoping, developing and monitoring data and analytics solutions in production.

• Hands-on skills in Power BI or another BI tool, SQL and Python.

• A high level of data literacy and the ability to explain data value and requirements to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• Experience working with and understanding complex enterprise architectures.

• A user-first mindset: you involve users early, work iteratively and check that business value is realised.

• Independence, ownership and drive, with strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

• Fluent English. Danish is not a requirement.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience with BI or manufacturing intelligence in API or Drug Product processes. Broader production experience is also relevant.

• Databricks and PySpark, as the team expects to use them more.

• ETL/ELT pipeline development, data modelling, orchestration (Databricks Jobs, Apache Airflow or similar), GitHub or Azure DevOps, CI/CD and automated testing.

• Experience with REST APIs and JSON, cloud platforms (Azure or AWS), and basic networking, security or Microsoft Entra ID concepts.

• Experience with manufacturing, time-series, MES, LIMS, DCS/SCADA or historian data, and with working in regulated GxP environments.

**What You’ll Do

**You will help CMC Pilots use data more and better to reach its operational and strategic goals. That means:

• Identify, scope, draft, develop and maintain data and analytics products for stakeholders in CMC Pilots.

• Help colleagues see where data can address their challenges and engage them in using it.

• Work with the central IT organisation on architecture, best practice and use cases.

• Communicate with key internal and external stakeholders, making decisions and keeping work moving.

• Support data analyst student assistants in their development and deliverables.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Data & Supply Chain team in CMC Pilots Business Support, part of CMC in Global Manufacturing & Supply. In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain from drug and device development to marketed Novo products, scaling molecules, processes, devices and products for the people who need them.

Your team has 15 professionals with varied cultural and educational backgrounds. They work on supply chain and production planning, business analytics and improvement projects, driven by exploration, process optimisation and solving complex business challenges. You will also partner with the central IT organisation and with stakeholders across CMC Pilots, and you will guide student assistants on the team.

Your main location is Bagsværd, in the Copenhagen area.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in a high-performing team where your expertise is valued and your voice is heard. You will own your work from first idea through implementation and validation and be trusted to take initiative. The team expects to use Databricks more, so there is room to build new skills as the data setup grows. You will learn from colleagues on the job, develop through relevant learning offerings, and be recognised for results.

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 DKK - 838,100 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to put data behind better decisions in pharmaceutical manufacturing, apply for the Advanced data analyst role by 1 December 2026. Please apply by submitting your CV including a brief motivation for applying.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.description:
**Why Faculty?

**We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

**Why the Faculty Fellowship?

**Founded in 2014, Faculty is one of Europe’s leading applied AI companies. Faculty’s PhD-heavy team of deep AI experts has delivered hundreds of real-world AI products to improve critical public services and drive sustained economic returns across every sector of the economy. Widely recognised as a leader in AI safety, Faculty works for the world’s leading AI labs, such as OpenAI, Meta and Anthropic, to ensure their latest models are safe, human-led and explainable.

The Faculty Fellowship builds the AI talent engine for the world’s most ambitious organisations. It selects exceptional scientific minds and accelerates them into the top tier of AI practitioners. Past Fellows hold some of the most critical AI posts for organisations across every sector of the economy.

As part of our international expansion, we are bringing the Faculty Fellowship to Denmark through Halfspace (part of Faculty), a leading applied AI company in Copenhagen. Building on Faculty’s decade-long track record of developing exceptional AI talent and Halfspace’s expertise in delivering real-world AI solutions, the Fellowship will offer outstanding STEM talent in Denmark an opportunity to accelerate their careers in AI. As a Fellow, you will learn directly from leading AI practitioners before being embedded within an ambitious organisation, applying advanced AI and data science to solve complex commercial challenges and deliver meaningful impact.

**How It Works

**

• 2 Weeks of Intensive Training: Learn to apply your advanced technical knowledge to real-world data science problems.

• 6 Week Paid Placement: Tackle a commercial data science project with a host company.

• Demo Day Finale: Present your work to senior stakeholders and industry leaders, showcasing your technical capabilities and project impact.

Where our alumni go: our alumni have gone on to shape the future at companies like Google, Meta, Tesco and AstraZeneca, as well as disruptive startups like Physics X and Orbital Witness. We are also incredibly proud that a high percentage of fellows choose to continue their journey internally, joining the Faculty team permanently.

**About The Role

**As a Fellow at Faculty, you will join an elite cohort transforming industries through cutting-edge data science. This intensive, eight week programme bridges academic and real world impact, embedding you directly into highs-stakes commercial environments. You will apply advanced machine learning techniques to solve complex, ambiguous problems for our clients, turning theoretical knowledge into high-value deployable solutions. It is a fast-paced launchpad designed to accelerate your technical growth, build exceptional commercial acumen and employer you to shape the future of artificial intelligence in an ambitious, forward-thinking tech community.

**Who We're Looking For

**

• You hold a finished PhD or Master’s degree in a STEM subject, complemented by a strong foundation in data science or machine learning.

• You possess a high level of mathematical competence alongside solid experience with theoretical concepts like hypothesis testing, Bayesian inference, and neural networks.

• You demonstrate strong programming skills, particularly in Python, and feel comfortable navigating core data science coding libraries.

• You bring an entrepreneurial mindset, showing the resilience and autonomy needed to structure your own project plans and hit critical deadlines.

• You can communicate complex technical ideas clearly, adapting your language seamlessly for both technical peers and non-technical partners.

• You thrive in fast-paced, ambitious environments, showing curiosity and a relentless drive to learn and deploy new technologies.

**Requirements

**

• Right to work: We’re unfortunately unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role, so you’ll need to already have the right to work in Denmark. This includes citizens of EU/EEA countries and Switzerland, as well as anyone holding a valid Danish work permit or residence status. If your eligibility is based on a visa or permit, please include the details in your application so we can review your situation.

• Location & Logistics: This is a fully in-person, eight-week programme based in Copenhagen, Denmark so you will need to be able to commute daily for the entire duration. Please keep in mind that Faculty is unable to provide or reimburse accommodation and travel expenses.

**Our Timelines

**

• December 2026: Coding tests sent via email.

• January 2026: Interviewing starts - held remotely online.

• February 2027: Final notifications sent to all applicants.

• March 2027*: Programme starts.

• Please note that programme dates are tentative and may be adjusted if required. We will notify all applicants of any updates and changes as early as possible.

What the Fellowship offers

• Paid Experience: Fellows receive a competitive stipend/salary for the full eight-week duration of the programme.

• Expert-Led Training: Two weeks of immersive lectures followed by weekly Friday masterclasses, bridging the gap between academic theory and commercial data science.Dedicated Mentorship: Receive ongoing support and guidance from experienced Faculty practitioners, gaining insight into how AI and data science are applied to solve real-world business challenges while developing your technical, commercial and communication skills.

• Real-World Value: A dedicated six-week placement embedded with a business, tackling a high-stakes data science challenge.

• Career Launchpad: A proven pathway into industry, backed by a decade-long track record of launching exceptional individuals into top-tier AI careers.

• Unrivalled Networking: Connect with a 500+ strong alumni community and pitch your project to 100+ industry guests at Demo Day.

**Our Recruitment Ethos

**We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

_Are you ready to spark transformation and make an impact at a leading global brand? Look no further!

_As part of our Digital and Technology organisation, we are looking for a Programme Manager to lead the rollout projects of our SAP S/4HANA solution across our core value chain. You will join our Delivery Excellence department, working closely with Delivery Leads, Project Managers, Programme Managers, and other delivery roles.

Our global SAP S/4HANA business transformation programme has established the foundation, template and delivery experience required to transform and standardize core business processes across Pandora. Having successfully progressed through the initial rollout waves, we are now entering the next phase: scaling deployment across markets and business units globally. Our ambition is to make each subsequent rollout faster, more efficient and increasingly repeatable, leveraging a mature global template, standardized delivery approach and lessons learned from previous deployments. This position will be instrumental in driving this evolution, taking ownership of end-to-end rollout delivery while helping build a scalable, high-performing rollout capability that combines speed and efficiency with strong business outcomes, adoption and delivery quality.

We would like to hear from you if you are passionate about orchestrating complex deliveries, a strong delivery leader who can guide and influence teams, and an enabler who fosters alignment and collaboration. You bring a structured yet empowering approach, grounded in a servant-leadership mindset. You have solid experience in programme management and have previously worked in roles such as Programme Manager, Project Manager, Delivery Manager, or similar, ideally within an SAP ECC or S/4HANA transformation. You do not need to be the SAP solution expert, but you understand what it takes to lead one, and you know the right questions to ask and when to challenge. You thrive in a fast-paced environment with diverse stakeholders, where your communication, coordination, and relationship-building skills are essential to driving successful outcomes.

**In Your Role As Programme Manager You Will

**

• Lead end-to-end delivery of SAP S/4HANA rollouts, from mobilization and design through build, testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare, ensuring delivery to agreed scope, timeline, budget and quality while protecting business continuity.

• Drive rollout scale, speed and efficiency, applying standardized ways of working, lessons learned and continuous improvement to make successive deployments increasingly predictable, repeatable and efficient.

• Mobilize and lead cross-functional rollout teams, securing the right business and technology resources, establishing clear accountabilities, governance and ways of working, and creating strong collaboration across global and local teams.

• Own the integrated rollout plan and critical path, actively managing dependencies, resource constraints, risks, issues and competing initiatives, identifying potential bottlenecks early and driving timely resolution.

• Partner closely with business leaders and functional teams to ensure business requirements are understood, the global template is adopted effectively, and the organization is ready for the change.

• Provide strong delivery governance and executive transparency, establishing relevant performance metrics, facilitating Steering Committees, enabling timely decision-making and escalating material risks or issues when required.

• Orchestrate execution across design, build and testing, ensuring scope and design decisions are aligned with template standards, build activities progress to plan, and integration and user acceptance testing provide confidence in business and solution readiness.

• Lead cutover and go-live readiness, coordinating business cutover, data migration, dress rehearsals, readiness assessments, contingency planning and go/no-go decision-making to enable a controlled and successful launch.

• Lead the transition into hypercare and steady-state operations, ensuring system stability, rapid resolution of critical issues, effective knowledge transfer and clear criteria for hypercare exit.

• Manage the performance of system integration and delivery partners, setting clear expectations, monitoring delivery against commitments and proactively addressing or escalating performance challenges.

• Champion continuous improvement across the rollout portfolio, translating experience and lessons learned into simpler processes, stronger delivery practices and opportunities to accelerate future rollouts.

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**

• Demonstrated experience leading complex programmes or large-scale transformations in a global organisation.

• Practical SAP S/4HANA programme experience, in a leadership role, covering stages from design and build through testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare

• Experience working with vendor-led delivery and SAP implementation partners.

• Strong coordination, communication, and organisational skills, with the ability to turn complexity into concise, actionable messages.

• Comfortable engaging senior stakeholders and driving challenging discussions and decisions.

• Comfortable working in matrixed, multi-team and international environments.

• A delivery mindset, taking ownership for outcomes and balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution.

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.
